title: If you allow magic In You will swirl in art abound No either Or just Both and AND Colors carried on Sounds of One. #smallpoems
summary: If you allow magic In You will swirl in art abound No either Or just Both and AND Colors carried on Sounds of One. #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
If you allow magic
In
You will swirl in
art abound

No either
Or
just
Both and
AND

Colors carried on
Sounds of
One.

#smallpoems
